title: The autorouter file of the small board
how: The file counts what the board holds: 2 copper layers, 2 components, 6 pads, 1 net with pads (A), 1 track and 2 vias as fixed wires;
padstacks: three different pad shapes with their layers (the round drilled pad, the rectangular surface pad, the round mounting hole)
and one via padstack, because the vias and the default via have the same size = 4.
